item.title: The Nutcracker — Nov 21, 2026
item.description: Hoff Family Arts & Culture Center Saturday, November 21, 2026 · 2:00 PM Visual splendor, a charming story, and brilliant classical dancing – it’s no wonder the world’s favorite holiday ballet is a family tradition! Fresh, lively, and thoroughly entertaining, The Nutcracker highlights the versatility of American Midwest Ballet’s cast of professional artists, backed by a polished ensemble of student dancers from across the metro area. Performances of The Nutcracker will be held November 21st at the Hoff Family Arts & Culture Center (1001 S. 6th Street, Council Bluffs, IA), and December 4th through 6th at Omaha’s Orpheum Theater (409 S. 16th Street, Omaha, NE). For more information or to purchase tickets, visit amballet.org/tickets. There will be a Sensory-Friendly performance held on Sunday, November 22nd. Contact American Midwest Ballet for more information. Source: KVNO Arts Calendar
